context_script:
# Fetch the survey document
context.survey = frappe.get_doc("Survey", {"name": frappe.form_dict.name})

# Check if the survey is closed
context.survey_closed = context.survey.closing_date_and_time and frappe.utils.get_datetime(context.survey.closing_date_and_time) < frappe.utils.now_datetime()
